10 : 12, tip: \"Restart the shift\", dispatch: () => this.onUi(\"restart\") },\n    );\n    const helpX = restartX - pad - navWidth;\n    this.button(\n      { x: helpX, y: bar.y + (bar.height - size) / 2, width: navWidth, height: size },\n      \"?\",\n      \"help\",\n      { size: compact ? 10 : 12, tip: \"How to Play\", dispatch: () => this.onUi(\"help\") },\n    );\n    const rightEdge = helpX - pad;\n\n    // Takings read against tonight's target, so the number always means\n    // something — \"$96\" alone tells the player nothing.\n    const goalCash = this.state.goal?.cash;\n    const amount = Math.round(this.state.outcomes.cash);\n    const formattedCash = amount < 0 ? `-$${Math.abs(amount)}` : `$${amount}`;\n    const cash = goalCash ? `${formattedCash}/$${goalCash}` : formattedCash;\n    // A 1-5 rating reads at a glance the way a percentage never does —\n    // \"3/5\" is a milestone a player recognizes instantly, not a figure they\n    // have to interpret.\n    const stars = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round((this.state.reputation ?? 50) / 20)));\n    const rating = `${stars}/5`;\n    const onTarget = !goalCash || this.state.outcomes.cash >= goalCash;\n    const cashText = this.add\n      .text(rightEdge, bar.y + bar.height / 2 - (compact ? 5 : this.px(6)), cash, {\n        color: onTarget ? \"#7ddc9f\" : \"#e8ddcc\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(10) : this.fs(12),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      })\n      .setOrigin(1, 0.5);\n    const repText = this.add\n      .text(rightEdge, bar.y + bar.height / 2 + (compact ? 6 : this.px(7)), `${rating}   ${this.state.outcomes.completed} served`, {\n        color: \"#f2cc5c\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n      })\n      .setOrigin(1, 0.5);\n\n    const trackX = x + pad;\n    const trackWidth = Math.max(16, rightEdge - Math.max(cashText.width, repText.width) - pad - trackX);\n    const trackHeight = compact ? 4 : this.px(6);\n    const trackY = bar.y + (bar.height - trackHeight) / 2;\n    g.fillStyle(0x4a3a2c);\n    g.fillRoundedRect(trackX, trackY, trackWidth, trackHeight, trackHeight / 2);\n    if (progress > 0) {\n      g.fillStyle(COLORS.pass);\n      g.fillRoundedRect(trackX, trackY, Math.max(trackHeight, trackWidth * progress), trackHeight, trackHeight / 2);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private zonePanel(\n    g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,\n    zone: ArenaRect,\n    color: number,\n    label: string,\n    compact: boolean,\n    vertical = false,\n  ): void {\n    g.fillStyle(color);\n    g.fillRoundedRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.width, zone.height, compact ? 3 : 5);\n    g.lineStyle(2, COLORS.ink, 0.5);\n    g.strokeRoundedRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.width, zone.height, compact ? 3 : 5);\n    const text = this.add.text(zone.x + this.px(5), zone.y + this.px(4), label, {\n      color: \"#3b2b20\",\n      fontFamily: \"Arial Narrow, sans-serif\",\n      fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n      fontStyle: \"bold\",\n    });\n    if (vertical) text.setOrigin(0.5, 0).setAngle(90).setPosition(zone.x + zone.width / 2, zone.y + zone.height / 2);\n  }\n\n  private drawKitchen(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.kitchen;\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    this.zonePanel(g, zone, COLORS.kitchen, \"KITCHEN\", compact);\n\n    const pad = compact ? 5 : this.px(8);\n    const top = zone.y + (compact ? 15 : this.px(20));\n    const oven = this.state.equipment.find((item) => item.kind === \"oven\");\n    const stock = Object.values(this.state.inventory).reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);\n    const stations: Array<{ label: string; sub: string; color: number; action?: string; tip?: string; dim?: boolean }> = [\n      { label: \"PREP\", sub: \"\", color: 0xf1e6c8 },\n      { label: \"PANTRY\", sub: `${stock} left`, color: 0xd4b483 },\n      {\n        label: \"OVEN\",\n        sub: oven?.status === \"failed\" ? \"DEAD — CLICK\" : oven?.status === \"degraded\" ? \"limping\" : \"ready\",\n        color: oven?.status === \"failed\" ? COLORS.failed : oven?.status === \"degraded\" ? 0xd6892f : COLORS.working,\n        action: oven?.status === \"failed\" ? \"inspect_oven\" : undefined,\n        tip: oven?.status === \"failed\" ? \"Fix the oven\" : undefined,\n      },\n    ];\n    // The one in-shift purchase on offer — a permanent second pair of hands\n    // at the stations, paid for out of tonight's own takings. Affordable\n    // once cash clears the cost; a one-time click, not a recurring cost.\n    const upgrade = this.state.upgrade;\n    if (upgrade) {\n      const affordable = this.state.outcomes.cash >= upgrade.cost;\n      stations.push(\n        upgrade.bought\n          ? { label: upgrade.label.toUpperCase(), sub: \"installed\", color: 0x8fbfa0 }\n          : {\n              label: `+${upgrade.label.toUpperCase()}`,\n              sub: `$${upgrade.cost} — click`,\n              color: affordable ? COLORS.pass : 0x5c4a3a,\n              action: affordable ? \"buy_second_stove\" : undefined,\n              tip: affordable ? \"Second pair of hands, all shift\" : `Need $${upgrade.cost} to install`,\n              dim: !affordable,\n            },\n      );\n    }\n\n    // On a real desktop window this zone can run far taller than these\n    // cards need — capped height plus vertical centering keeps them a\n    // sensible size instead of stretching into empty slabs.\n    const rawStationHeight = (zone.height - (top - zone.y) - pad * (stations.length + 1)) / stations.length;\n    const stationHeight = Math.min(compact ? 40 : this.px(76), Math.max(this.px(14), rawStationHeight));\n    const groupHeight = stationHeight * stations.length + pad * (stations.length - 1);\n    const groupTop = top + Math.max(0, (zone.height - (top - zone.y) - groupHeight) / 2);\n\n    stations.forEach((station, index) => {\n      const y = groupTop + index * (stationHeight + pad);\n      const rect = { x: zone.x + pad, y, width: zone.width - pad * 2, height: stationHeight };\n      g.fillStyle(station.color, station.dim ? 0.6 : 1);\n      g.fillRoundedRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, 3);\n      g.lineStyle(1, COLORS.kitchenDark, 0.8);\n      g.strokeRoundedRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, 3);\n      const broken = station.label === \"OVEN\" && oven?.status === \"failed\";\n      this.add\n        .text(zone.x + zone.width / 2, y + stationHeight / 2 - (station.sub ? this.px(4) : 0), station.label, {\n          color: broken ? \"#ffffff\" : \"#2b2118\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0.5);\n      if (station.sub) {\n        this.add\n          .text(zone.x + zone.width / 2, y + stationHeight / 2 + this.px(5), station.sub, {\n            color: broken ? \"#ffe2e2\" : \"#5c4a3a\",\n            fontFamily: MONO,\n            fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n            fontStyle: \"bold\",\n          })\n          .setOrigin(0.5);\n      }\n      if (station.action) this.hotspot(rect, station.action, station.tip);\n    });\n  }\n\n  private drawPass(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.pass;\n    this.zonePanel(g, zone, COLORS.pass, \"PASS\", layout.compact, true);\n    this.hotspot(zone, \"verify_substitution\", \"Verify the ticket\");\n    const y = zone.y + zone.height * 0.6;\n    g.fillStyle(0x7b4c2e);\n    g.fillRoundedRect(zone.x + 3, y, zone.width - 6, layout.compact ? 12 : this.px(18), 3);\n    // Plates waiting on the pass = orders cooked but not yet run to a table.\n    const ready = this.state.orders.filter((order) => order.status === \"ready\").length;\n    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(3, ready); i++) {\n      g.fillStyle(0xfff3d6);\n      g.fillCircle(\n        zone.x + zone.width / 2,\n        y + this.px(4) + i * (layout.compact ? 5 : this.px(7)),\n        layout.compact ? 2.5 : this.px(3.5),\n      );\n    }\n    if (ready > 0) {\n      this.add\n        .text(zone.x + zone.width / 2, zone.y + zone.height - this.px(4), `${ready}`, {\n          color: \"#2b2118\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: layout.compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0.5, 1);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private drawDining(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.dining;\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    this.zonePanel(g, zone, COLORS.dining, \"DINING\", compact);\n\n    const tables = this.state.tables.slice(0, 4);\n    const top = zone.y + (compact ? 15 : this.px(19));\n    const available = Math.max(24, zone.height - (top - zone.y) - this.px(4));\n    const cols = tables.length > 2 ? 2 : tables.length || 1;\n    const rows = Math.ceil(tables.length / cols) || 1;\n\n    tables.forEach((table, index) => {\n      const col = index % cols;\n      const row = Math.floor(index / cols);\n      const cx = zone.x + (zone.width * (col + 0.5)) / cols;\n      const cy = top + (available * (row + 0.5)) / rows;\n      // Capped at a fixed 18px, tables read as a sparse handful of dots on a\n      // real desktop window where this zone is much bigger than a 520px\n      // canvas — let them grow with the room, not just with the cell they\n      // have to fit in.\n      const fitsCell = Math.min(zone.width / cols, available / rows) * 0.3;\n      const styleCap = compact ? 13 : Math.min(32, 18 + Math.max(0, zone.width - 360) * 0.03);\n      const radius = Math.max(8, Math.min(styleCap, fitsCell));\n\n      // Chairs first so the table top sits over them.\n      const seats = Math.min(table.seats, 4);\n      for (let seat = 0; seat < seats; seat++) {\n        const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * seat) / seats - Math.PI / 2;\n        g.fillStyle(0x8a5a34);\n        const ring = radius + this.px(5);\n        g.fillCircle(cx + Math.cos(angle) * ring, cy + Math.sin(angle) * ring, compact ? 2.5 : this.px(3.5));\n      }\n      g.fillStyle(table.status === \"occupied\" ? COLORS.occupied : COLORS.empty);\n      g.fillCircle(cx, cy, radius);\n      g.lineStyle(2, COLORS.cream, 0.85);\n      g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, radius);\n\n      const order = this.state.orders.find((o) => o.tableId === table.id && o.status !== \"served\" && o.status !== \"cancelled\");\n      this.add\n        .text(cx, cy, table.id.replace(\"table-\", \"T\"), {\n          color: \"#ffffff\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0.5);\n\n      if (order) {\n        // A plate icon on the table once the food is up, so the floor shows\n        // what the ticket rail says.\n        if (order.status === \"ready\") {\n          g.fillStyle(0xfff8e7);\n          g.fillCircle(cx + radius * 0.7, cy - radius * 0.7, compact ? 3 : this.px(4));\n        }\n        if (order.allergy) {\n          this.add\n            .text(cx, cy - radius - (compact ? 6 : this.px(8)), \"!\", {\n              color: \"#ffffff\",\n              backgroundColor: \"#c73535\",\n              fontFamily: MONO,\n              fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n              fontStyle: \"bold\",\n              padding: { x: 3, y: 0 },\n            })\n            .setOrigin(0.5);\n        }\n        const index3 = Number((table.id.match(/\\d+/) ?? [\"0\"])[0]);\n        if (index3 >= 1 && index3 <= 3 && order.priority !== \"high\") {\n          this.hotspot(\n            { x: cx - radius - 4, y: cy - radius - 4, width: radius * 2 + 8, height: radius * 2 + 8 },\n            `rush_table_${index3}`,\n            `Rush ${table.id.replace(\"table-\", \"table \")}`,\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /** The door: who is waiting, and a host stand you can actually see. */\n  private drawDoor(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.door;\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    const held = Boolean(this.state.seatingHeld);\n    const waiting = this.state.waiting ?? [];\n    const crowded = waiting.length >= 3 && !held;\n    this.zonePanel(g, zone, held ? 0xc9a4a0 : COLORS.door, \"DOOR\", compact);\n    if (held) {\n      g.lineStyle(3, COLORS.failed, 0.95);\n      g.strokeRoundedRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.width, zone.height, compact ? 3 : 5);\n      this.add.rectangle(zone.x + 2, zone.y + 1, zone.width - 4, this.px(3), COLORS.failed).setOrigin(0, 0).setDepth(5);\n    }\n\n    const stand = layout.doorStand;\n    const fill = held ? COLORS.failed : crowded ? 0x4a3a2c : 0x5a4636;\n    const bg = this.add.rectangle(stand.x, stand.y, stand.width, stand.height, fill).setOrigin(0, 0);\n    bg.setStrokeStyle(2, held || crowded ? COLORS.cream : COLORS.ink, held ? 0.95 : 0.55);\n    bg.setDepth(6);\n    const titleX = stand.x + stand.width / 2 + (held ? this.px(6) : 0);\n    if (held) {\n      const lockX = stand.x + this.px(10);\n      const lockY = stand.y + stand.height / 2;\n      const shackle = this.add.circle(lockX, lockY - this.px(5), this.px(3.5), fill, 0).setDepth(7);\n      shackle.setStrokeStyle(2, COLORS.cream, 0.95);\n      this.add.rectangle(lockX, lockY + this.px(1), this.px(8), this.px(7), COLORS.cream).setOrigin(0.5).setDepth(7);\n    }\n    const title = held ? \"DOOR HELD\" : \"HOLD DOOR\";\n    // The two lines are pinned to the stand's own edges rather than to raw\n    // scaled offsets, so a short stand (it has a 22px floor) cannot end up\n    // with its caption pushed out through the bottom.\n    const titleGap = Math.min(compact ? 6 : this.px(8), stand.height * 0.3);\n    const footGap = Math.min(compact ? 4 : this.px(5), stand.height * 0.22);\n    this.add\n      .text(titleX, stand.y + titleGap, title, {\n        color: \"#fff3d6\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      })\n      .setOrigin(0.5, 0)\n      .setDepth(7);\n    this.add\n      .text(stand.x + stand.width / 2, stand.y + stand.height - footGap, held ? \"H to open\" : \"press H\", {\n        color: \"#f2cc5c\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      })\n      .setOrigin(0.5, 1)\n      .setDepth(7);\n    this.hotspot(stand, \"hold_seating\", held ? \"H — open the door and start seating\" : \"H — stop seating new tables\", 8);\n    if (crowded) this.tweens.add({ targets: bg, alpha: 0.55, duration: 420, yoyo: true, repeat: -1 });\n\n    const textLeft = stand.x + stand.width + this.px(6);\n    if (waiting.length === 0) {\n      this.add\n        .text(textLeft, zone.y + zone.height / 2 + this.px(2), held ? \"Held — nobody waiting\" : \"Nobody waiting\", {\n          color: \"#3b2b20\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0, 0.5);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const y = zone.y + zone.height * 0.62;\n    const parties = waiting.slice(0, 5);\n    // Cards grow with the type, but never past the room left of the zone edge.\n    const gap = this.px(4);\n    const room = zone.x + zone.width - this.px(4) - textLeft;\n    const cardWidth = Math.max(16, Math.min(compact ? 26 : this.px(34), room / parties.length - gap));\n    const cardHeight = compact ? 15 : this.px(19);\n    parties.forEach((party, index) => {\n      const x = textLeft + index * (cardWidth + gap);\n      g.fillStyle(held ? 0xe8d4c4 : 0xfff3d6);\n      g.fillRoundedRect(x, y - cardHeight * 0.58, cardWidth, cardHeight, 3);\n      this.add\n        .text(x + cardWidth / 2, y - cardHeight * 0.2, `×${party.size}`, {\n          color: \"#2b2118\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0.5);\n      const barInset = Math.min(this.px(3), cardWidth * 0.15);\n      const barWidth = cardWidth - barInset * 2;\n      const barY = y + cardHeight * 0.22;\n      const barHeight = Math.max(2, this.px(3));\n      const patience = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, party.patience));\n      this.add.rectangle(x + barInset, barY, barWidth, barHeight, 0x4a3a2c, 0.7).setOrigin(0, 0.5);\n      const barFill = this.add\n        .rectangle(x + barInset, barY, Math.max(1, barWidth * patience), barHeight, loadColor(1 - patience))\n        .setOrigin(0, 0.5);\n      if (patience < 0.3) this.tweens.add({ targets: barFill, alpha: 0.3, duration: 380, yoyo: true, repeat: -1 });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /** Ticket rail: every live order as a card you can click to rush. */\n  private drawTickets(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.tickets;\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    g.fillStyle(COLORS.panel);\n    g.fillRoundedRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.width, zone.height, 4);\n    this.add.text(zone.x + this.px(6), zone.y + this.px(4), \"TICKETS\", {\n      color: \"#f2cc5c\",\n      fontFamily: \"Arial Narrow, sans-serif\",\n      fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n      fontStyle: \"bold\",\n    });\n\n    const live = this.state.orders.filter((order) => order.status !== \"served\" && order.status !== \"cancelled\");\n    const top = zone.y + (compact ? 14 : this.px(17));\n    const cardHeight = zone.height - (top - zone.y) - this.px(4);\n\n    if (live.length === 0) {\n      this.add\n        .text(zone.x + zone.width / 2, top + cardHeight / 2, \"No tickets\", {\n          color: \"#8d8378\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n        })\n        .setOrigin(0.5);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const gap = this.px(4);\n    const inset = this.px(4);\n    // Cards keep their type-relative width, so a rail twice as tall shows the\n    // same number of legible tickets rather than the same number of tiny ones.\n    const minCard = compact ? 74 : this.px(92);\n    const maxCards = Math.max(1, Math.min(live.length, Math.floor((zone.width - inset * 2) / minCard)));\n    const cardWidth = (zone.width - inset * 2 - gap * (maxCards - 1)) / maxCards;\n\n    live.slice(0, maxCards).forEach((order, index) => {\n      const x = zone.x + inset + index * (cardWidth + gap);\n      const rect = { x, y: top, width: cardWidth, height: cardHeight };\n      g.fillStyle(COLORS.ticket);\n      g.fillRoundedRect(x, top, cardWidth, cardHeight, 3);\n      if (order.priority === \"high\") {\n        g.lineStyle(2, COLORS.alert, 0.9);\n        g.strokeRoundedRect(x, top, cardWidth, cardHeight, 3);\n      }\n\n      const table = (order.tableId ?? order.id).replace(\"table-\", \"T\").replace(/order-x?/, \"#\");\n      this.add.text(x + inset, top + this.px(3), table, {\n        color: \"#2b2118\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(8) : this.fs(10),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      });\n      this.add\n        .text(x + cardWidth - inset, top + this.px(3), order.status.toUpperCase(), {\n          color: \"#ffffff\",\n          backgroundColor: hex(STATUS_COLORS[order.status]),\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n          padding: { x: 2, y: 1 },\n        })\n        .setOrigin(1, 0);\n      this.add.text(x + inset, top + (compact ? 15 : this.px(19)), order.items.join(\" + \") || \"—\", {\n        color: \"#4f4136\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n      });\n\n      if (order.allergy) {\n        this.add\n          .text(x + inset, top + cardHeight - this.px(3), `${order.allergy.toUpperCase()} ALLERGY`, {\n            color: \"#ffffff\",\n            backgroundColor: \"#c73535\",\n            fontFamily: MONO,\n            fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n            fontStyle: \"bold\",\n            padding: { x: 2, y: 1 },\n          })\n          .setOrigin(0, 1);\n      } else if (order.priority === \"high\") {\n        this.add\n          .text(x + inset, top + cardHeight - this.px(3), \"RUSHED\", {\n            color: \"#ffffff\",\n            backgroundColor: \"#e08b2c\",\n            fontFamily: MONO,\n            fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n            fontStyle: \"bold\",\n            padding: { x: 2, y: 1 },\n          })\n          .setOrigin(0, 1);\n      }\n\n      const tableIndex = Number((order.tableId?.match(/\\d+/) ?? [\"0\"])[0]);\n      if (order.priority !== \"high\" && tableIndex >= 1 && tableIndex <= 3) {\n        this.hotspot(rect, `rush_table_${tableIndex}`, \"Rush this ticket\");\n      } else if (order.allergy) {\n        this.hotspot(rect, \"prioritize_allergy\", \"Prioritize allergy ticket\");\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (live.length > maxCards) {\n      this.add\n        .text(zone.x + zone.width - this.px(5), zone.y + this.px(5), `+${live.length - maxCards}`, {\n          color: \"#f2cc5c\",\n          fontFamily: MONO,\n          fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n          fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        })\n        .setOrigin(1, 0);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The service log. Watching the staff think is what makes their behaviour\n   * legible — and a legible floor is what makes the player's calls informed.\n   */\n  private drawFeed(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const zone = layout.feed;\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    g.fillStyle(COLORS.panel);\n    g.fillRoundedRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.width, zone.height, 4);\n    this.add.text(zone.x + this.px(6), zone.y + this.px(4), \"EVENT FEED\", {\n      color: \"#f2cc5c\",\n      fontFamily: \"Arial Narrow, sans-serif\",\n      fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n      fontStyle: \"bold\",\n    });\n\n    // Keep the narrative spine visible while the activity log scrolls past it.\n    // This is deliberately fixed-order UI, not inferred from whichever feed\n    // entries happen to be in the tail of a long shift.\n    const milestoneTop = zone.y + (compact ? 14 : this.px(18));\n    const milestone = this.add.text(zone.x + this.px(6), milestoneTop, milestoneFeedText(), {\n      color: \"#c9bdae\",\n      fontFamily: MONO,\n      fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(6),\n      fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      wordWrap: { width: zone.width - this.px(12) },\n      maxLines: layout.feedBeside ? 2 : 1,\n      lineSpacing: compact ? 1 : this.px(2),\n    });\n    void milestone;\n\n    const entries = this.state.feed ?? [];\n    const top = milestoneTop + milestone.height + (compact ? 2 : this.px(4));\n    // The side rail is narrow but tall, so entries there get a second line\n    // rather than being cut off mid-sentence.\n    const bodyLines = layout.feedBeside ? 2 : 1;\n    const lineHeight = (compact ? 15 : this.px(18)) + (bodyLines - 1) * (compact ? 7 : this.px(9));\n    const rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor((zone.height - (top - zone.y) - this.px(2)) / lineHeight));\n    const shown = entries.slice(-rows);\n\n    if (shown.length === 0) {\n      this.add.text(zone.x + this.px(6), top + this.px(2), \"Press Play to open.\", {\n        color: \"#8d8378\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(7) : this.fs(9),\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    shown.forEach((entry, index) => {\n      const y = top + index * lineHeight;\n      const color = VOICE_COLORS[entry.voice] ?? \"#c9bdae\";\n      // The player's own calls get a left accent rule and full-strength body\n      // text, so \"what I decided\" separates from \"what the staff said\" at a\n      // glance rather than only by reading the name (#304). The feed is the\n      // record of the shift; a manager scanning it back should be able to\n      // find their own decisions without parsing every line.\n      const mine = entry.voice === \"you\";\n      const accent = mine ? this.px(4) : 0;\n      const textX = zone.x + this.px(6) + accent;\n      if (mine) {\n        g.fillStyle(0x7ddc9f);\n        g.fillRoundedRect(zone.x + this.px(3), y, this.px(2), lineHeight - (compact ? 3 : this.px(4)), 1);\n      }\n      const head = this.add.text(textX, y, `${entry.clock} ${entry.who}`, {\n        color,\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(7),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n      });\n      this.add.text(textX, y + (compact ? 7 : this.px(8)), entry.text, {\n        color: entry.kind === \"thought\" ? \"#9a8f82\" : mine ? \"#fff3d6\" : \"#e8ddcc\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(8),\n        fontStyle: entry.kind === \"thought\" ? \"italic\" : \"normal\",\n        wordWrap: { width: zone.width - this.px(12) - accent },\n        maxLines: bodyLines,\n      });\n      void head;\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ── Staff avatars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  private visualLocation(worker: RestaurantArenaState[\"workers\"][number]): Location {\n    // Holding the door plants the host on the stand so the lock is a person,\n    // not a chip. A host already assigned into the kitchen stays there.\n    if (\n      worker.role === \"host\" &&\n      this.state.seatingHeld &&\n      (worker.location === \"queue\" || worker.location === \"floor\")\n    ) {\n      return \"queue\";\n    }\n    return worker.location;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The zone a member of staff is drawn in: whatever the state says, unless the\n   * player has just dropped them somewhere else and the state has not come back\n   * yet. A dropped token stays in the room it was dropped in.\n   */\n  private assignedLocation(worker: RestaurantArenaState[\"workers\"][number]): Location {\n    const visual = this.visualLocation(worker);\n    const pending = this.pendingAssign.get(worker.role);\n    if (!pending) return visual;\n    const settled = pending.target === visual;\n    if (settled || Date.now() - pending.at > RestaurantArenaScene.ASSIGN_GRACE_MS) {\n      // Either the game agreed, or it was never going to: back to the state.\n      this.pendingAssign.delete(worker.role);\n      return visual;\n    }\n    return pending.target;\n  }\n\n  private stackedSlot(location: Location, offset: number, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): ArenaPoint {\n    const step = layout.compact ? 17 : this.px(22);\n    const slot = layout.waypoints[location];\n    // Staff at the door stand *beside* the host stand rather than on top of it:\n    // the stand carries the hold-the-door control, and a token parked over it\n    // would eat the click.\n    if (location !== \"queue\") return { x: slot.x + offset * step, y: slot.y };\n    const lead = layout.doorStand.width / 2 + step / 2;\n    const room = layout.door.x + layout.door.width - step / 2;\n    return { x: Math.min(slot.x + lead + offset * step, room), y: slot.y };\n  }\n\n  private drawWorkers(layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const compact = layout.compact;\n    const offsets = new Map<Location, number>();\n    this.staffTokens.clear();\n\n    for (const worker of this.state.workers) {\n      const location = this.assignedLocation(worker);\n      const offset = offsets.get(location) ?? 0;\n      offsets.set(location, offset + 1);\n      const slot = this.stackedSlot(location, offset, layout);\n      // The walker owns the pixel position; the slot is only where it is\n      // *heading*. A repaint mid-walk (or mid-drag) therefore rebuilds the\n      // token where the person currently is, not back at their station.\n      const walker = this.walker(worker.role, location, slot);\n      if (walker.node !== location || (!walker.walking && !walker.dragging && this.awayFrom(walker, slot))) {\n        walker.setTarget(location, this.slotWaypoints(layout, location, slot), layout.spineY);\n      }\n\n      const token = this.buildAvatar(walker.x, walker.y, worker.role, worker.load, compact);\n      // Somebody on the move doesn't idle-bob: that tween owns the token's y,\n      // and `update` is about to own it instead.\n      if (walker.walking || walker.dragging) this.tweens.killTweensOf(token);\n      this.staffTokens.set(worker.role, token);\n      const heldHost = worker.role === \"host\" && Boolean(this.state.seatingHeld) && location === \"queue\";\n      const status = heldHost ? \"acting\" : (this.workerStatuses.get(worker.role) ?? this.workerStatus(worker));\n      this.drawWorkerBadge(token, status, compact, heldHost);\n      this.drawSpeechBubble(token, worker.role, compact);\n      this.makeDraggable(token, worker.role, location, layout);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private walker(role: Role, location: Location, slot: ArenaPoint): StaffWalker {\n    const existing = this.walkers.get(role);\n    if (existing) return existing;\n    const walker = new StaffWalker(location, slot);\n    this.walkers.set(role, walker);\n    return walker;\n  }\n\n  private awayFrom(walker: StaffWalker, slot: ArenaPoint): boolean {\n    return Math.hypot(walker.x - slot.x, walker.y - slot.y) > 1;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The walk graph's waypoints, with this walker's own stacked slot standing in\n   * for the destination — two cooks in the same kitchen shouldn't finish their\n   * walks standing inside each other.\n   */\n  private slotWaypoints(\n    layout: RestaurantArenaLayout,\n    location: Location,\n    slot: ArenaPoint,\n  ): Record<Location, ArenaPoint> {\n    return { ...layout.waypoints, [location]: slot };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Drag a member of staff onto another zone to reassign them — the same\n   * `assign_<role>_<location>` action the keyboard and the agents use, except\n   * you point at where you want them.\n   *\n   * Dropping is the only part that talks to the game. Everything before it is\n   * local: the token follows the pointer, the zone under it lights up, and any\n   * repaint the shift asks for in the meantime is held by the gate so the thing\n   * being dragged is still there to be dropped.\n   */\n  private makeDraggable(\n    token: Phaser.GameObjects.Container,\n    role: Role,\n    from: Location,\n    layout: RestaurantArenaLayout,\n  ): void {\n    // A grab box a bit taller than the figure, so the badge over their head and\n    // the name tag under their feet are part of the person, not dead space.\n    const reach = this.px(layout.compact ? 26 : 30);\n    token.setInteractive(\n      new Phaser.Geom.Rectangle(-reach / 2, -reach * 0.85, reach, reach * 1.5),\n      Phaser.Geom.Rectangle.Contains,\n    );\n    this.input.setDraggable(token);\n    // \"You can pick this person up\" has to be discoverable without a legend.\n    if (token.input) token.input.cursor = \"grab\";\n\n    const halo = this.add.rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0).setOrigin(0, 0).setDepth(19).setVisible(false);\n    halo.setStrokeStyle(2, COLORS.pass, 0.95);\n\n    token.on(\"dragstart\", () => {\n      this.repaintGate.beginDrag();\n      this.draggingRole = role;\n      const walker = this.walkers.get(role);\n      if (walker) walker.dragging = true;\n      // The idle bob is a tween on this container's y; it would fight the\n      // pointer for the token.\n      this.tweens.killTweensOf(token);\n      token.setDepth(40);\n      token.setAlpha(0.92);\n    });\n\n    token.on(\"drag\", (_pointer: Phaser.Input.Pointer, dragX: number, dragY: number) => {\n      token.setPosition(dragX, dragY);\n      const walker = this.walkers.get(role);\n      if (walker) {\n        walker.x = dragX;\n        walker.y = dragY;\n      }\n      const drop = this.zoneAt(dragX, dragY, layout);\n      const rect = drop && drop !== from ? this.zoneRect(drop, layout) : undefined;\n      if (rect) {\n        halo.setPosition(rect.x, rect.y).setSize(rect.width, rect.height).setVisible(true);\n      } else {\n        halo.setVisible(false);\n      }\n    });\n\n    token.on(\"dragend\", () => {\n      halo.setVisible(false);\n      token.setAlpha(1);\n      token.setDepth(20);\n      const walker = this.walkers.get(role);\n      if (walker) walker.dragging = false;\n      this.draggingRole = undefined;\n      const drop = this.zoneAt(token.x, token.y, layout);\n      const reassigned = drop !== undefined && drop !== from;\n      if (reassigned) {\n        // Left standing where they were dropped, in the zone they were dropped\n        // into, so the walk that follows is the short one onto their slot\n        // rather than a march back out of the room they just left.\n        walker?.snap({ x: token.x, y: token.y }, drop);\n        this.onAction(`assign_${role}_${drop}`);\n      }\n      // Whatever the shift asked for while the token was in the air happens\n      // now — including the repaint for the assignment just dispatched.\n      const owed = this.repaintGate.endDrag();\n      if (owed || reassigned) this.paint();\n      // Dropped where they already were, or off the floor entirely: they walk\n      // back to their station rather than staying stuck under the cursor.\n      else this.walkHome(role, from, layout);\n    });\n  }\n\n  /** Which zone a pixel belongs to, or `undefined` for none of them. */\n  private zoneAt(x: number, y: number, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): Location | undefined {\n    const zones: [Location, ArenaRect][] = [\n      [\"queue\", layout.door],\n      [\"kitchen\", layout.kitchen],\n      [\"pass\", layout.pass],\n      [\"floor\", layout.dining],\n    ];\n    for (const [location, rect] of zones) {\n      if (x >= rect.x && x <= rect.x + rect.width && y >= rect.y && y <= rect.y + rect.height) return location;\n    }\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  private zoneRect(location: Location, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): ArenaRect {\n    if (location === \"kitchen\") return layout.kitchen;\n    if (location === \"pass\") return layout.pass;\n    if (location === \"queue\") return layout.door;\n    return layout.dining;\n  }\n\n  /** Send someone back to the station they are still assigned to. */\n  private walkHome(role: Role, location: Location, layout: RestaurantArenaLayout): void {\n    const walker = this.walkers.get(role);\n    if (!walker) return;\n    const slot = this.stackedSlot(location, this.stackOffset(role, location), layout);\n    walker.setTarget(location, this.slotWaypoints(layout, location, slot), layout.spineY);\n  }\n\n  /** This role's place in the queue of staff standing in the same zone. */\n  private stackOffset(role: Role, location: Location): number {\n    let offset = 0;\n    for (const worker of this.state.workers) {\n      if (worker.role === role) return offset;\n      if (this.visualLocation(worker) === location) offset += 1;\n    }\n    return offset;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Walks in progress. Tokens are moved in place rather than repainted: a walk\n   * is sixty frames of motion, and repainting the floor for each of them would\n   * throw away every hotspot under the player's cursor sixty times a second.\n   */\n  update(_time: number, delta: number): void {\n    const layout = this.layout;\n    if (!layout) return;\n    // Walks run at the shift's own speed, so 4× service looks like 4× service.\n    // A stopped clock still lets a walk finish, though: a token left frozen\n    // halfway across the floor — after a drag during a decision, say — reads as\n    // a bug rather than as a pause.\n    const speed = this.running ? (this.state.sim?.speed ?? 1) : 1;\n    for (const [role, walker] of this.walkers) {\n      const token = this.staffTokens.get(role);\n      if (role === this.draggingRole) continue;\n      const before = walker.walking;\n      if (walker.step(delta, speed)) {\n        token?.setPosition(walker.x, walker.y);\n        const figure = token?.getByName(\"figure\");\n        if (figure && \"setScale\" in figure) {\n          (figure as Phaser.GameObjects.Container).setScale(walker.facing, 1);\n        }\n      }\n      // The hop that just landed leaves the token parked wherever it stopped;\n      // give it its idle breathing back, around the new spot, so a member of\n      // staff who has arrived doesn't read as frozen.\n      if (before && !walker.walking && token) this.startIdleBob(token, walker.y, role);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The service log tells the same story in a rail nobody has to be\n   * looking at — a bubble over the actual person doing the thinking is\n   * what makes the floor read as staffed by someone, not just occupied.\n   */\n  private latestLineFor(role: Role): string | undefined {\n    const feed = this.state.feed;\n    if (!feed || feed.length === 0) return undefined;\n    for (let i = feed.length - 1; i >= Math.max(0, feed.length - 6); i--) {\n      const entry = feed[i]!;\n      if (entry.voice === role && (entry.kind === \"thought\" || entry.kind === \"action\")) return entry.text;\n    }\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  private drawSpeechBubble(token: Phaser.GameObjects.Container, role: Role, compact: boolean): void {\n    const line = this.latestLineFor(role);\n    if (!line) return;\n    const trimmed = line.length > 46 ? `${line.slice(0, 44)}…` : line;\n    const label = this.add.text(0, 0, trimmed, {\n      color: \"#2b2118\",\n      fontFamily: MONO,\n      fontSize: compact ? this.fs(6) : this.fs(7),\n      wordWrap: { width: compact ? 100 : this.px(130) },\n      maxLines: 2,\n      align: \"center\",\n    });\n    const padX = this.px(5);\n    const padY = this.px(4);\n    const w = label.width + padX * 2;\n    const h = label.height + padY * 2;\n    const edge = this.px(4);\n    const localX = Math.min(Math.max(-w / 2, edge - token.x), this.cssWidth - w - edge - token.x);\n    const bubbleY = -(compact ? 20 : this.px(26)) - h;\n    const bg = this.add.rectangle(0, 0, w, h, 0xfff3d6, 0.96).setOrigin(0, 0);\n    bg.setStrokeStyle(1, ROLE_COLORS[role], 0.9);\n    label.setPosition(padX, padY);\n    const tailW = this.px(4);\n    const tail = this.add\n      .triangle(w / 2 - localX, h + tailW, -tailW, 0, tailW, 0, 0, this.px(5), 0xfff3d6)\n      .setOrigin(0.5, 0);\n    const bubble = this.add.container(localX, bubbleY, [bg, label, tail]);\n    bubble.setAlpha(0.97);\n    token.add(bubble);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Pixel staff figure shared by floor tokens and the pre-shift roster.\n   */\n  private avatarFigure(role: Role, unit: number): Phaser.GameObjects.GameObject[] {\n    const color = ROLE_COLORS[role];\n    const parts: Phaser.GameObjects.GameObject[] = [];\n\n    const shoulderY = unit * 2;\n    const shoulderX = unit * 2.9;\n    const shoulderR = unit * 1.15;\n    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {\n      const shoulder = this.add.circle(shoulderX * side, shoulderY, shoulderR, color);\n      shoulder.setStrokeStyle(1, 0x2b2118, 0.6);\n      parts.push(shoulder);\n    }\n\n    const bodyW = unit * 5;\n    const bodyH = unit * 5;\n    const body = this.add.graphics();\n    body.fillStyle(color, 1);\n    body.fillRoundedRect(-bodyW / 2, unit * 1.5 - bodyH / 2, bodyW, bodyH, unit * 1.5);\n    body.lineStyle(1, 0x2b2118, 0.75);\n    body.strokeRoundedRect(-bodyW / 2, unit * 1.5 - bodyH / 2, bodyW, bodyH, unit * 1.5);\n    parts.push(body);\n    if (role === \"chef\" || role === \"supply_lead\" || role === \"expediter\") {\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, unit * 2.6, unit * 3, unit * 2.6, 0xfff3d6, 0.92).setOrigin(0.5));\n    }\n    if (role === \"host\") {\n      // Bun behind the crown so the face is not painted over.\n      const bun = this.add.circle(0, -unit * 4.5, unit * 1.55, 0x4a3040);\n      bun.setStrokeStyle(1, 0x2b2118, 0.6);\n      parts.push(bun);\n    }\n    const head = this.add.circle(0, -unit * 2.2, unit * 2.3, 0xf6d5b0);\n    head.setStrokeStyle(1, 0x2b2118, 0.6);\n    parts.push(head);\n    if (role === \"chef\") {\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, -unit * 3.9, unit * 4, unit * 1.1, 0xfffdf6).setOrigin(0.5));\n      parts.push(this.add.circle(0, -unit * 5, unit * 2, 0xfffdf6));\n    } else if (role === \"host\") {\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, -unit * 3.7, unit * 4.2, unit * 1.2, 0x4a3040).setOrigin(0.5));\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, unit * 0.4, unit * 1.1, unit * 1.1, 0xf2cc5c).setOrigin(0.5).setAngle(45));\n    } else if (role === \"server\") {\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, unit * 0.4, unit * 1.6, unit * 1.1, color).setOrigin(0.5));\n    } else {\n      parts.push(this.add.rectangle(0, -unit * 4, unit * 4.4, unit * 1.3, color).setOrigin(0.5));\n    }\n    parts.push(this.add.rectangle(-unit * 0.8, -unit * 2.2, unit * 0.6, unit * 0.8, 0x2b2118).setOrigin(0.5));\n    parts.push(this.add.rectangle(unit * 0.8, -unit * 2.2, unit * 0.6, unit * 0.8, 0x2b2118).setOrigin(0.5));\n    return parts;\n  }\n\n  private buildRosterAvatar(x: number, y: number, role: Role, compact: boolean): Phaser.GameObjects.Container {\n    const unit = compact ? 1.8 : this.px(2.15);\n    const token = this.add.container(x, y, this.avatarFigure(role, unit));\n    token.setDepth(62);\n    return token;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * A little pixel-ish cook rather than a coloured dot: the floor has to\n   * read as a room with people in it.\n   */\n  private buildAvatar(\n    x: number,\n    y: number,\n    role: Role,\n    load: number,\n    compact: boolean,\n  ): Phaser.GameObjects.Container {\n    // People grow with the room: a 2.6-unit cook is right for a 520px floor\n    // and a speck on a 1440p one, and you can't drag what you can't see.\n    const unit = compact ? 2 : this.px(2.6);\n    const figureParts = this.avatarFigure(role, unit);\n    const clamped = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, load));\n    if (clamped > 0.5) {\n      const plate = this.add.ellipse(unit * 3.2, unit * 2.4, unit * 2.4, unit * 1.1, 0xfff8e7);\n      plate.setStrokeStyle(1, 0x2b2118, 0.7);\n      plate.setName(\"carry\");\n      figureParts.push(plate);\n    }\n    const figure = this.add.container(0, 0, figureParts);\n    figure.setName(\"figure\");\n    const parts: Phaser.GameObjects.GameObject[] = [figure];\n    const staff = this.staff(role);\n    const nameTag = this.add\n      .text(0, unit * 4.6, staff.name, {\n        color: \"#2b2118\",\n        backgroundColor: \"#fff3d6\",\n        fontFamily: MONO,\n        fontSize: compact ? this.fs(5) : this.fs(7),\n        fontStyle: \"bold\",\n        padding: { x: 2, y: 1 },\n      })\n      .setOrigin(0.5, 0);\n    parts.push(nameTag);\n\n    const barWidth = unit * 6;\n    const barHeight = Math.max(2, unit);\n    parts.push(this.add.rectangle(-barWidth / 2, -unit * 6.4, barWidth, barHeight, 0x241b14, 0.9).setOrigin(0, 0.5));\n    const fill = this.add\n      .rectangle(-barWidth / 2, -unit * 6.4, Math.max(1, barWidth * clamped), barHeight, loadColor(clamped))\n      .setOrigin(0, 0.5);\n    parts.push(fill);\n\n    const token = this.add.container(x, y, parts);\n    token.setDepth(20);\n    if (clamped > 0.8) this.tweens.add({ targets: fill, alpha: 0.3, duration: 380, yoyo: true, repeat: -1 });\n    if (this.running) this.startIdleBob(token, y, role);\n    return token;\n  }\n\n  private workerStatus(worker: RestaurantArenaState[\"workers\"][number]): RestaurantArenaWorkerStatus {\n    if (this.state.emergency?.active) return \"error\";\n    return worker.load > 0.8 ? \"acting\" : worker.load > 0.5 ? \"thinking\" : \"idle\";\n  }\n\n  private drawWorkerBadge(\n    token: Phaser.GameObjects.Container,\n    status: RestaurantArenaWorkerStatus,\n    compact: boolean,\n    holdingDoor = false,\n  ): void {\n    const labels: Record<RestaurantArenaWorkerStatus, string> = {\n      idle: \"READY\",\n      thinking: \"THINKING…\",\n      acting: holdingDoor ? \"HOLDING\" : \"ON IT\",\n      error: \"HELP!\",\n    };\n    const colors: Record<RestaurantArenaWorkerStatus, number> = {\n      idle: COLORS.working,\n      thinking: COLORS.pass,\n      acting: holdingDoor ? COLORS.failed : COLORS.door,\n      error: COLORS.alert,\n    };\n    const badgeY = compact ? -17 : -this.px(23);\n    const badge = this.add.text(0, badgeY, labels[status], {\n      color: status === \"thinking\" ?
